The main takeaway from our work is that

a single set of parameters for the model can provide a robust control of the ankle prosthesis across a variety of walking conditions, including level-ground, ramp ascent, ramp descent and speed transitions.
neuromuscular control of powered ankle prostheses can be used to adaptively control energy consumption in response to terrain variation.
